```yaml
name: Nuitka Linux Build
on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      
      - name: Set up Python
        uses: pytorch/pytorch/.github/actions/setup-linux@main
        with:
          python-version: '3.9'
          compiler: 'gcc'
          
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install nuitka
          pip install -r requirements.txt
          
      - name: Build with Nuitka
        run: |
          python -m nuitka --onefile --enable-plugin=numpy --output-dir=dist/ dirsearch.py
          
      - name: Handle Nuitka output name differences
        run: |
          # Check if the output file exists with different naming conventions
          if [ -f "dist/dirsearch" ]; then
            echo "Output file found with standard name"
          elif [ -f "dist/dirsearch.exe" ]; then
            echo "Output file found with Windows extension"
            mv "dist/dirsearch.exe" "dist/dirsearch"
          else
            echo "Error: Could not find Nuitka output file"
            exit 1
          fi
          
      - name: Upload artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: dirsearch-nuitka
          path: dist/
```
